quarterly_data.quarter: MaxLinear press release: CMS and MaxLinear Expand OpenZFS Storage for AI, Cloud, and (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Core Micro Systems (CMS), a Japan-based company, has adopted the MaxLinear Panther platform (Panther V) as the hardware acceleration foundation for its next-generation storage solutions, combining the Panther Storage Accelerator with ZFlush hardware-accelerated OpenZFS (compression, encryption, deduplication). CMS plans to deploy Panther-based storage solutions for hyperscale, enterprise, cloud and AI infrastructure customers across Asia. MaxLinear SVP Vikas Choudhary called it 'an important step in expanding adoption of the MaxLinear Panther platform'. No volume or revenue figure stated.
